[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' deviceA
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKeyA , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : FreshKeyA , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , 'secret' : Secret , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'signKey' cloudA | (deviceA ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , 'secret' : Secret , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'signedKey' UserX | (deviceA ; encrypt(Key,Secret)) .
[B4] < UserX | 'signedKey' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'signedKey' UserX | (deviceA ; SignedKey)
=> < UserX | 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceA | (SignedKey)
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceA , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < deviceA | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , ... > if SignedKey == encrypt(Key,Secret) .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (deviceA ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserY , TrustedUsers) , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , Rest) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (deviceA ; UserY)
=> < cloudA | deviceA : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > if UserX =/= UserY .
